alkylation reagent: Samples were denatured, reduced, and alkylated in 5% (w/v) sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS), 10 mM tris (2-carboxyethyl) phosphine hydrochloride (TCEP-HCl), 40 mM 2-chloroacetamide, 50 mM Tris pH 8.5 and boiled at 95 °C for 10 min.
alkylation concentration: Samples were denatured, reduced, and alkylated in 5% (w/v) sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS), 10 mM tris (2-carboxyethyl) phosphine hydrochloride (TCEP-HCl), 40 mM 2-chloroacetamide, 50 mM Tris pH 8.5 and boiled at 95 °C for 10 min.
cleavage agent: Lys-C/Trypsin mix (Promega) was added for 1:50 protease to protein ratio in 50 mM Tris pH 8.5 and incubated rotating at 37 °C overnight.
collision energy: The top 12 most intense peaks were isolated with 1.4 m/z window with a 100 ms fill time and 1E6 AGC target and 27% HCD collision energy for MS2 spectra collected at 15,000 resolution.
fragmentation method: The top 12 most intense peaks were isolated with 1.4 m/z window with a 100 ms fill time and 1E6 AGC target and 27% HCD collision energy for MS2 spectra collected at 15,000 resolution.
instrument: Peptides were detected with a Thermo Q-Exactive HF-X mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific)
labeling: Peptides were detected with a Thermo Q-Exactive HF-X mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific)
precursor tolerance: The mass tolerances for the database search were 4.5 ppm for the precursors and 20 ppm for the MS2 fragment ions
fragment tolerance: The mass tolerances for the database search were 4.5 ppm for the precursors and 20 ppm for the MS2 fragment ions
ptm: Cysteine carbamidomethylation (fixed); methionine oxidation (variable); protein N-terminal acetylation (variable); lysine side chain acetylation (variable)
Cysteine carbamidomethylation was searched as a fixed modification, while methionine oxidation, protein N-terminal and lysine side chain acetylation were treated as variable modifications.
